facts.statement: Once the mission is complete, players head to Bone Marsh when an in-game announcement says the dance contest is about to begin, and wear vampire or werewolf costume pieces.
facts.quote: Cuando veas un anuncio en el juego que indique “el concurso de baile esta por comenzar”

article_summaries.title: Vampiros vs. Hombres Lobos (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post describing a Spooktacular season event in which vampire and werewolf sides compete in a dance contest for the Pumpkin King. Players take a mission from Madame Zelda in Shadowbrook to choose a side, then join the contest at Bone Marsh when the in-game announcement appears; the side with the most fans wins a piece of the Pumpkin King's special cake.
